veranderings.voor: Net soos ons het die boere
veranderings.na: Net soos ons, het die boere
veranderings.rede: Without a comma a Grade 5 reader can first parse 'ons het die boere' as subject-verb-object; the comma closes the fronted comparison and removes the garden path.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The BESKERM list holds 'HOU: nyanga' and also 'HOU: inyanga, NIE: nyanga'; the two entries contradict each other. The lesson uses only 'inyanga', so nothing is affected here, but the list should be reconciled.
